Reviewed and wrote `review-verdict.json`: **reject**.

This task produced zero real work — every checkpoint in task.yaml shows `files_modified: []`, the branch HEAD sits exactly at the merge-base with master (confirmed no commits were ever made), and PROGRESS.md just says "Not started." It never got past its own pre-flight gate, which is ironic since it was dispatched specifically to fix that gate's failure loop. The `adopted_existing_pr` field pointing to compliance-tracker PR #580 is a supervisor bug — it mis-attached an unrelated PR (belonging to the original chat-context/mode-pill feature task, not this RCA task) after `gh pr create` failed against an empty `master` branch twice. No `known_fixes` row was registered, so the task's own stated success criteria were never met. There's no real diff here to approve.
